title: Indicator of an input-length query
statement: For a binary string $y$ and an index $a\in\mathbb N$, the Boolean indicator of the language of encoded pairs whose index is less than the string length, evaluated at the encoding of $y$ and the binary representation of $a$, equals the Boolean decision of whether $a<|y|$.
hypotheses_covered: An index a in the natural numbers
